description: Start the review of a pushed idea: it leaves draft, Monnet reviews the spec and the next people on the plan are added. Call it only after the person has said to start the review. Waits for Monnet's review comment and returns it as it is. An older Monnet backend may not support push: the error then says so.

idea_short_id.description: The first 8 characters of the idea UUID, as push_idea returned it.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: kick_off_idea
